participant.left.media_timeout.reason: Janus never removes a participant for media failure: a PeerConnection hangup only unpublishes (participant stays, publisher:false). With consent freshness and hangup_on_failed off, silent media loss may produce no hangup at all (docs).

native: evh session timeout -> plugin unpublished -> plugin leaving

participant.left.replaced.reason: Janus never evicts on identity reuse; a same-feed-id join is refused with 436 (participant.rejoin.rejected).

participant.rejoin.rejected.evidence: J3; no evh event, others not told

participant.signal.lost.evidence: J2, J4. Transport ids are reused across connections: bind by time.

participant.signal.reclaimed.reason: Impossible in this deployment: reclaim_session_timeout=0 destroys the session on WS close. Becomes possible (claim -> success, no evh event) if reclaim>0; that is a server-config study variable.
